role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You write a patch proposal that rewrites the old result-communication lines. You change nothing yourself.

inline_inputs.label: The five old lines found in the repo (file and line)
inline_inputs.text:
agents/grace.md line 19: GTT Center Perth never communicates clinical results.
agents/ivy.md line 50: GTT procedure is in-house (phlebotomist); lab analysis is offsite (WDP/PathWest); Ivy never communicates test results.
docs/onboarding.md line 150: GTT Center Perth does not communicate blood test results. Results are sent by WDP/PathWest directly to the referring GP. Clients must follow up with their GP.
docs/pathology-partnership-brief.md line 155: GTT Center Perth never communicates results to patients. Results go WDP to GP to patient.
docs/consent-form.md section 1: We do NOT communicate your GTT results to you. Results are sent by the laboratory to your referring doctor.

inline_inputs.label: The locked positive-result pathway (Anthony, R15 and R19)
inline_inputs.text: The lab sends the result to the requesting midwife. Urgent results are phoned within 1 hour. The midwife phones the woman. A short results consult happens within 3 business days. A referral letter is issued within 2 business days. GTT does not take over diabetes care. The midwife is employed by GTT Medical Services. The lab, not GTT, analyses the sample.

deliverable.format: A table with one row per old line (file, line, old text, new text, one-line reason). Then 3 lines on what the owner of each file should check.
deliverable.write_only: the patch table and the check lines
deliverable.do_not_write: edits to any file, any clinical advice, any new timing not in the inputs

extra_checks: Every new line keeps the fact that the lab analyses the sample and GTT does not diagnose.
Five rows, one per old line.
